name: Haiti
dossier:
The Haiti national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Les Grenadiers, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 83 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CONCACAF to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Returning after 52 years, Haiti represents the Caribbean's pride and ultimate underdog spirit.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Haiti will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group C and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group C. The connection between Frantzdy Pierrot and Duckens Nazon is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Frantzdy Pierrot - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Haiti are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Haiti's only previous appearance was in West Germany 1974, where they scored a famous goal against Dino Zoff's Italy.
Haiti boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Group stage (1974).
